title: Autopay Discount Amounts and Timing — Home-Site Lease
content:
A Home-Site Lease enrolled in automatic ACH payment earns a monthly credit against site rent. The schedule below gives, for each lot class, the amount of that monthly credit, how many calendar days before the rent due day enrollment must be completed for the credit to apply to that month, and for how many billing periods the credit is withheld after an autopay draft is returned.

| Lot class | Autopay discount (USD per month) | Enrollment completed at least this many days before the due day | Billing periods withheld after a returned draft |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 10.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 10.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 15.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 15.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 15.00 | 5 | 3 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 20.00 | 5 | 3 |

**Questions on the schedule**

*Which lot class earns the largest autopay credit?* The Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site, at 20.00 a month; the single-section lot classes earn 10.00 and the other multi-section lot classes 15.00.

*How long is the withholding after a returned draft?* Three billing periods on every lot class.

*What is the enrollment cutoff?* Five calendar days before the rent due day on every lot class.
